content.comment_body: Good morning, I am trying to install the latest [version_no] of [product_name] software on my PC, but I am missing the original media for the previous version and all earlier installations have been replaced with new computers. What is the best way to obtain a software download so I can continue programming my PLC devices?
A complete version is not available for download, only updates are provided online. You will need to purchase a new DVD. [product_name] [version_no]: Order number [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing difficulty upgrading to the newest software version due to the absence of original installation media, which is necessary for updating. The lack of online options to obtain the full software after hardware replacement causes workflow disruption and limits accessibility.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an option to download or acquire a full software version after losing the original disc, instead of needing to purchase another physical copy.
